import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit import Model, Parameters
from lmfit.models import PseudoVoigtModel, LinearModel, ExponentialModel
d=pd.read_csv('../syn-AsI3-01/spectrum.csv'); x=d.shift_cm1.values
y=np.load('y_clean.npy')
lo,hi=60,260
m=(x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xs=x[m]; ys=y[m]

def build(centers):
    mod=LinearModel(prefix='bg_')+ExponentialModel(prefix='ex_')
    pars=mod.make_params(bg_intercept=1500,bg_slope=0,ex_amplitude=6000,ex_decay=60)
    pars['ex_decay'].set(min=5,max=500)
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
        pk=PseudoVoigtModel(prefix=f'p{i}_')
        mod=mod+pk
        pars.update(pk.make_params())
        pars[f'p{i}_center'].set(value=c,min=c-4,max=c+4)
        pars[f'p{i}_sigma'].set(value=3,min=0.5,max=15)
        pars[f'p{i}_amplitude'].set(value=3000,min=0)
        pars[f'p{i}_fraction'].set(value=0.5,min=0,max=1)
    return mod,pars

def run(centers):
    mod,pars=build(centers)
    r=mod.fit(ys,pars,x=xs)
    return r

if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    cents=[float(c) for c in sys.argv[1].split(',')]
    r=run(cents)
    print(r.fit_report(min_correl=0.9))
    print('BIC',round(r.bic,1),'chi2',round(r.chisqr,0))
    np.save('resid.npy', r.residual)
    import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,8),sharex=True)
    ax[0].plot(xs,ys,'k.',ms=3); ax[0].plot(xs,r.best_fit,'r-')
    comps=r.eval_components(x=xs)
    for k,v in comps.items():
        if k.startswith('p'): ax[0].plot(xs,v+comps['bg_']+comps['ex_'],'--',lw=0.8)
    ax[1].plot(xs,r.residual,'k-',lw=0.6)
    plt.savefig('fit.png',dpi=90)
